purpose: M2 review corrections: own revocation handle in the libc, delivery acceptance checks, immediate take of the delivery, GRANT node admission and refusals in the monitor, region reuse through the process cache; lying-launcher and node-pressure gate cases
method: run-mapping-gate.sh: boot 1 runs fifteen cases (basic, refresh, two, errors, cycle, large, signal without injection, ro-store, alias-fault, then under capstone-exec-adversary: release-noop alias-fault, widen ro-refused, signal injection, double grant, grant to a preempted domain); boot 2 runs budget with CAPSTONE_REV_NODES=512. Each case requires its exit status; markers per case. Controls: the same cases against the previous libc (image built from b5318db86d41 with the new contract source), and against the previous monitor, driver and launcher (876a04b / df907c2 / b5318db86d41 build). SQLite memory gate with the lane module and a host rebuilt against the lane libcapstone.
